title: Headless review declaration
description: Which runtimes may review this repository headless, with which lenses and caps. Read by `agentic-task dispatch` from the protected base commit only; a copy on a pull-request branch has no effect. Absence of the file, or of a runtime in it, means no headless run for that runtime. This is the per-repository answer to plan decision 8 (cross-vendor review of private code) for the headless path.

lenses.description: Every lens listed is required: each runs headless and posts its findings, then one aggregate verdict is posted for the tuple (any NEEDS_CHANGES blocks; a failed or verdict-less lens means no verdict). Lens prompts are read from .agents/prompts/ on the protected base.

max_minutes.description: Wall-clock cap enforced by the dispatcher for every runtime.

max_turns.description: Agent-turn cap. Enforced through the runtime's own flag; declaring it for a runtime whose binary cannot enforce it fails the precheck.

max_usd.description: Spend cap passed to the runtime where it has one (Claude's --max-budget-usd). The journal records the cost the runtime reports.

model.description: Optional model name or alias passed to the runtime.

retries.description: How many further attempts a failed or uncertain-post run may get for the same tuple, each after a readback shows nothing was posted.
